name: Gungan catapult
description: Gungan catapults, also called gungan energy catapults or whizboomas, were mobile weapons that were used by the Gungans in the Battle of Naboo/Legends against invading Trade Federation droids. The catapults launched large boomas that deactivated the enemy droids. The catapult was made of hornweed.

data.name: Gungan catapult
data.purpose: Providing fire from a distance with boombas
